rationale: Before mitigation: 9 of 10 measurements (90%) fall within the normal band [0.90, 1.10] pu, below the required 95%. One measurement at t03 (0.889 pu) falls below the normal band. Applying a +0.025 pu tap correction shifts all voltages up by 0.025 pu, bringing t03 to 0.914 pu (within normal band) and t09 to 1.091 pu (still within normal band). This achieves 100% compliance within the normal band while respecting absolute limits [0.85, 1.10] pu.
